acceptance_criteria.criterion: node scripts/build-personas.js --check runs automatically in at least one of: pre-commit hook, CI pipeline, or npm lifecycle script
A stale persona file causes the guard to fail and block the pipeline/commit
The chosen approach is documented in the root README.md
The guard does not silently fail or get skipped in normal development workflow

summary: Chose Option A (npm lifecycle pretest) over Husky or CI-only. Added 'pretest': 'node ../scripts/build-personas.js --check' to mcp-server/package.json.
Verified the guard runs automatically on npm test: pretest fires, prints [ok] for all 14 personas, then the Vitest suite runs.
Verified stale detection: appending content to a persona file causes [stale] in check output + exit code 1, blocking the test run entirely.
Documented the Persona Freshness Guard in README.md with usage instructions for all three invocation methods (npm test pretest, direct check, personas/npm run check).
982 tests pass with the guard in place.

comments.note: No root-level package.json exists in this workspace (split into mcp-server/ and personas/ sub-packages). The pretest hook was added to mcp-server/package.json because that is the sub-package developers run npm test in regularly. The path ../scripts/build-personas.js is correct since mcp-server/ is a direct child of the workspace root. Stale exit tested: guard shows [stale] and exits with code 1, blocking npm test via pretest hook.

summary: "pretest": "node ../scripts/build-personas.js --check" verified in mcp-server/package.json.
Stale detection test: appended content to personas/ledger/vs-code/4-qa.md; node scripts/build-personas.js --check showed [stale] 4-qa.md and exited 1.
Blocking test: ran npm test with stale file — pretest fired, showed [stale], exited 1. Vitest never started. Guard correctly blocks npm test pipeline.
Clean recovery: rebuilt persona, subsequent check shows all [ok] x14. npm test then runs 982 tests successfully.
README.md documents "Persona Freshness Guard" at line 63 with usage for all three invocation methods (pretest, direct, personas npm).
Edge-case: silent failure checked — pretest exit code 1 propagates correctly as npm test exit code 1. No swallowing.

comments.note: Stale detection tested end-to-end: file appended -> [stale] shown -> exit 1 -> npm test blocked. Clean recovery after rebuild confirmed. No silent failure path found.

summary: Reviewed mcp-server/package.json and root README.md.
pretest hook correctly placed: 'node ../scripts/build-personas.js --check'. Path resolution is correct (mcp-server/ is a direct workspace child, ../scripts/... resolves to workspace root).
Hook placement in scripts block is consistent with existing predev hook pattern.
README Persona Freshness Guard section is clear: problem statement, automatic trigger, three invocation methods, and recovery instructions all present.
QA verified exit code propagation — exit 1 from pretest blocks npm test with no silent swallowing.
982 tests pass with guard active. No blocking issues found.
Non-blocking suggestion: guard scope is mcp-server npm test only; a git pre-commit hook would extend coverage to personas-only workflows.

comments.note: The pretest hook covers developers running npm test from mcp-server/. Developers who work exclusively in personas/ would not trigger the guard. This is acceptable given the WP spec's 'at least one of' requirement, and the README honestly documents all three invocation paths. A future enhancement (pre-commit via Husky or lefthook) would cover the personas/ case, but this is non-blocking for the current WP scope.
